question: Is the left hair-plate relay (IN03A066/075/080) necessary for LF posterior coxa MN firing, and is activity in the right copies sufficient to raise RF posterior coxa MN firing, in the Step C A_ON context?
known_before_registration: Step C A_ON saved run (pool and per-neuron window rates, including relay and sham candidate rates used for set resolution), RF excitation V1 result (type weights, right relay silent). No intervention arm has run; the 100-step smoke test is plumbing only and its output is discarded.

sources.step_c_module: malecns_backend.live.hair_plate_posture (Trial, mn_sets, tilt_deg, save/load; its protocol() hash lock)

context: Step C A_ON for every arm: assisted posture, hair plates delivered, same seed, schedule and encoder, 20 channels, no coxa channel, 20000 physics steps, 4000 neural ticks. One fresh process per arm, each run once.

set_rules.edge: floored edge: synapse count >= min_synapses (6); excitatory: MaleCNSBrain.pre_sign > 0
set_rules.side: hair_plate_identity.side_of on the annotations row of the body id
set_rules.LEFT_RELAY: type in {IN03A066, IN03A075, IN03A080}; left; floored edge from any LF SNpp45; excitatory floored edge onto a V1 LF posterior coxa MN
set_rules.RIGHT_RELAY: same types; right; excitatory floored edge onto a V1 RF posterior coxa MN
set_rules.SHAM: same size; type starts with IN03A; same side; not in either relay set and not in the external schedule; no floored edge (any sign) onto any replayed coxa MN (V1 posterior and anterior pools of all legs plus Step C coxa MNs, 62 neurons); for each relay neuron in dense order, the unused candidate with the closest saved A_ON window rate, ties to lowest dense index
set_rules.injection_rate: each RIGHT_RELAY neuron: mean A_ON window rate of LEFT_RELAY neurons of its own type; RIGHT_SHAM neuron i receives exactly the train of RIGHT_RELAY neuron i
set_rules.train: numpy.random.default_rng(20261102).random((4000, n)); event at tick t for neuron j when u[t, j] < rate_j * dt / 1000; covers all 4000 ticks (tick = index into the neural record)

arms.C0: no intervention; must reproduce saved A_ON
arms.L_SIL: brain.transmission_withheld_indices = LEFT_RELAY for the whole run
arms.L_SHAM: brain.transmission_withheld_indices = LEFT_SHAM for the whole run
arms.R_INJ: trains OR-ed into the Step C Trial event_trials forced mask for RIGHT_RELAY, only when the neuron is available (not refractory); engine forced-event semantics

integrity.I2: per-tick uniforms_sha256 and external schedule identical to C0 in every arm
integrity.I3: C0 equals saved A_ON in fired, uniforms_sha256, hair_delivered at every tick and qpos at every sample
integrity.I4: per tick: recorded transmission_withheld equals fired intersected with the silenced set (empty in other arms); injected and blocked partition the scheduled train events, injected events are in fired; every intervention arm has at least one intervention event
integrity.I5: every intervention arm equals C0 in fired for ticks before its first intervention event and in qpos for samples 0..5*t0
integrity.failure: INCONCLUSIVE_INTEGRITY, no labels; evaluation also refuses if set resolution does not reproduce 'resolved' or the A_ON hash differs

measures.pool_rate: V1 posterior coxa MN pool rate per leg in the window
measures.spillover: other legs' pools and the MNs of the 20 admitted channels (session observer.used)
measures.sensory_confound: window-mean hair_rate_hz of the primary leg (LF for L arms, RF for R arms) vs C0; |relative change| > 0.10 sets SENSORY_CONFOUNDED (reported with the label, not instead of it)
measures.descriptive: V1 replay and V2 attribution of primary best MNs (withheld spikes removed from delivery), contribution from each set; first physical/neural divergence from C0; tilt mean/peak over samples 5201..; injection events blocked by refractoriness

Q_SUF.RESCUED: R_INJ RF pool rate >= 0.5 x C0 LF pool rate

predictions: Recorded in the design doc: Q_NEC CONTRIBUTES; Q_SUF PARTIAL.
interpretation_limits: One seed, assisted posture, open-loop coxa (no coxa channel admitted).
Withheld transmission and forced-event injection are engineering manipulations of the model, not models of biological manipulations.
The relay types were chosen after the passive RF excitation result; this is a prospective test of that post-hoc hypothesis.
A causal role in the model does not separate real anatomy from reconstruction artifact and admits no motor coordinate.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed; no reruns, no rule changes.
